svg.title: MCP tools and a hosted agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.desc: MCP tools and a hosted agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. 10 components in 2 groups. Connections: MCP clients to AgentCore Gateway (tool calls); AgentCore Gateway to AgentCore Policy (authorize); AgentCore Gateway to AgentCore Runtime (MCP); AgentCore Runtime to AgentCore harness (ask_architect); AgentCore Runtime to Outputs bucket (save); AgentCore harness to Amazon Bedrock (reason); AgentCore harness to AWS Knowledge MCP server (read docs); AgentCore Gateway to AgentCore harness (tool calls); AgentCore harness to AgentCore Memory; AgentCore Runtime to Amazon CloudWatch (traces); AgentCore harness to Amazon CloudWatch (traces).

text.tspan: MCP tools and a hosted agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
Clients call the tools through an IAM gateway with Cedar rules; ask_architect hands a whole request to the hosted agent
